turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My nephew wants a dinosaur birthday cake and I'm weighing up how to pull it off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ooh, can you just listen while I run through the choices? Then I'll ask what you think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could carve a sheet cake into a dinosaur shape and cover it in green buttercream.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a simpler idea, a plain round cake with plastic dinosaur toys stomping across the top.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a volcano cake with orange icing dripping down and little dinosaurs around the base.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My sister also suggested dinosaur shaped cookies instead of a cake at all.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The carved dinosaur is the most impressive but also the easiest to go wrong. The volcano is dramatic without needing sculpting skills. The round cake with toys is foolproof, and he gets to keep the dinosaurs.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you ring your dad about Sunday lunch, Ananya?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I quit coffee three days ago and my head is killing me. Is this normal?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Very normal, sadly. Caffeine withdrawal headaches usually peak in the first couple of days and fade within about a week.
